decisions.reason: After several years and no later market visibility, this conferencing offer looks peripheral to the firm's infrastructure-led strategy and its upside has likely been overtaken by stronger specialist competition.
Metro data-centre connectivity is tightly aligned with the firm's owned network assets, cloud trajectory and enterprise customer base, so it still merits continuation even if branding may evolve.
Optical spectrum connectivity remains a strategically important high-bandwidth service that leverages core fibre infrastructure and fits the firm's move toward advanced integrated connectivity.

The number-ordering portal is a low-cost digital extension of the existing voice business, so management would keep it while it supports automation and customer retention, even if it may be folded into a broader platform later.
Carrier pre-selection is a legacy telephony product with weak fit to the firm's software-defined growth path, so the option value is now very limited and resources are better redeployed.

Direct voice network connection still sits close to the core enterprise connectivity offer and can retain value for installed customers, so management would keep it unless demand deteriorates further.
